description: Core validation rules applied to all data sources (FHIR, CSV, XPT)

rules.name: resource_type_present
rules.description: Resource must have a type identifier
rules.condition: resourceType field is NULL or empty
rules.rationale: Cannot parse file without knowing resource structure

rules.name: resource_id_present
rules.description: Resource must have a unique identifier
rules.condition: id field is NULL or empty
rules.rationale: Cannot track records or detect duplicates without ID

rules.name: temporal_field_derivable
rules.description: At least one temporal field must exist to derive period_id
rules.condition: ALL of (period.start, period.end, actualPeriod.start) are NULL
rules.rationale: Cannot assign processing month for time-series analysis
rules.v2_relaxed: Requires at least ONE temporal field

rules.name: temporal_precision_flag
rules.description: Flag records with single temporal field
rules.rationale: Reduced temporal precision may affect month assignment accuracy

rules.name: date_format_valid
rules.description: Date fields must parse to valid ISO 8601
rules.condition: Date field present but does not match YYYY-MM-DD[THH:MM:SS[.sss][Z]]
rules.rationale: Cannot extract month or perform temporal calculations
rules.action_on_failure: Drop row if <5% affected; fail file if >=5%

rules.name: dtype_coercion_tolerance
rules.description: Allow sentinel values to be normalized before dtype casting
rules.rationale: Common missing value indicators should be converted to NULL

rules.name: row_level_failure_threshold
rules.description: File passes if <5% of metric-critical rows fail validation
rules.condition: Metric-critical row failures >= 5% of total rows
rules.rationale: Systematic data quality issues invalidate file

rules.name: nullable_dtypes_required
rules.description: Use pandas nullable dtypes (Int64, Float64, boolean)
rules.condition: Dtype cast fails due to NA in non-nullable int64/float64/bool
rules.rationale: Legitimate missingness should not cause dtype errors

rules.name: latency_non_negative
rules.rationale: Negative latency indicates timestamp calculation error
rules.action_on_failure: Fail file (system error, not data quality issue)

validation_workflow.step_6: Calculate validation_passed = (no errors OR <5% row failures)
validation_workflow.step_7: Log results and proceed to metric calculation
